mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, flagship_id, name, type, shop_code, status, archived_at, logo, description, business_hours, address, contact_phone, city, district, total_sales, rating, created_at FROM shops WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'mall' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id LIMIT 1

SELECT id, owner_id, flagship_id, name, type, shop_code, status, archived_at, logo, description, business_hours, address, contact_phone, city, district, total_sales, rating, created_at FROM shops WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND type = 'mall' AND archived_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT id, owner_id, flagship_id, name, type, shop_code, status, archived_at, logo, description, business_hours, address, contact_phone, city, district, total_sales, rating, created_at FROM shops WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'mall' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at, id

SELECT id, owner_id, flagship_id, name, type, shop_code, status, archived_at, logo, description, business_hours, address, contact_phone, city, district, total_sales, rating, created_at FROM shops WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND type = 'service' AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, id

SELECT id, owner_id, flagship_id, name, type, shop_code, status, archived_at, logo, description, business_hours, address, contact_phone, city, district, total_sales, rating, created_at FROM shops WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT s.* FROM shops AS s INNER JOIN users AS owner ON owner.id = s.owner_id AND owner.status = 'normal' WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.status = 'open' AND s.archived_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE shops SET name = #{name}, shop_code = #{shopCode}, description = #{description}, business_hours = #{businessHours}, address = #{address}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, logo = #{logo} WHERE id = #{id} AND archived_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.username AS merchant_name FROM shops AS s LEFT JOIN users AS u ON s.owner_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE shops SET status = #{status} WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
